overview.text: Assign design tickets in Jira, Linear, Asana or ClickUp and get designs in your Figma in 24–48 hours, with a human reviewer in the loop.

offerings.text: Uses your tokens, components and styles straight from your Figma library. No random colors, no detached components.
Always reviewed by a human to ensure quality and coherence.
New screens look like they've always been part of your app, maintaining same patterns, tone, and logic.

problems.text: Product teams or developers need to quickly obtain high-quality UI/UX designs consistent with their existing product design system.

valueProposition.text: Receive senior-reviewed, production-ready design screens integrated into Figma efficiently, maintaining design consistency and quality.

differentiators.text: Integration with popular design management tools Jira, Linear, Asana or ClickUp streamlines assignment.
Use of customer's actual Figma tokens, components and styles avoids inconsistent design output.
Human-in-the-loop review guarantees quality, not just AI output.
New designs blend seamlessly into existing products, maintaining UX consistency.

idealCustomers.text: Product managers and developers in tech companies who rely on design management tools and value design consistency and speed.
Design teams looking to outsource rapid design production without loss of quality or integration.
Agencies managing multiple product clients needing quick turnaround and consistent design output.

buyerPersonas.text: Product Manager - needs quick, reliable design output to keep sprints on schedule.
Lead Developer - values design consistency to reduce rework and maintain code/design harmony.
Design Lead - insists on senior-reviewed output to meet quality standards and brand guidelines.

geographicFocus.text: Not specified - likely global SaaS market focus given tool integrations and remote work trends.

evidence.text: Product teams using Jira, Linear in startups often need fast, consistent designs to meet tight deadlines.
Agencies managing diverse clients value consistency and speed, matching product's strengths.

segments.name: Internal Design Teams at Mid-size Companies

evidence.text: Teams needing human-reviewed design delivery aligns with product's human reviewer feature.

buyingSignals.text: Prospects looking for Figma-integrated design production with human review in 24-48h timeframe.
Users frustrated by inconsistent or detached components in outsourced designs.

missingInformation.text: Market demand validation, buyer persona prioritization, pricing sensitivity.

positioning.text: Position Greensighter AI Designer as the quickest, highest-quality, and most design-consistent AI-assisted design tool for product and design teams using existing design management workflows.

acquisitionChannels.title: LinkedIn Outreach to Product Teams

recommendation.text: Use LinkedIn to target Product Managers and Lead Developers in tech startups for initial trial offers, testing messaging around speed and design system consistency.

steps: Identify company and role targets using LinkedIn Sales Navigator
Send personalized connection requests with messaging emphasizing 24-48h turnaround and design consistency
Follow up with a tailored demo invitation
acquisitionChannels.successMetric: Response rate >10%, demo scheduling >5% of contacts

acquisitionChannels.title: Digital Agency Webinars

recommendation.text: Host webinars targeting Digital Product Agencies showcasing human-reviewed design outputs integrated with Figma and client branding consistency.

steps: Develop webinar content highlighting review process and integration benefits
Promote webinar via agency networks and LinkedIn groups

acquisitionChannels.title: Figma Community Engagement

recommendation.text: Engage Figma user groups and forums to demonstrate seamless use of their tokens and components, attracting internal design teams who value quality review.

steps: Create content and tutorials showing product integration with Figma
acquisitionChannels.successMetric: Engagement post interaction rate >8%, trial signups >5%
